{
  "up": "Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, molecule_dictionary.first_approval
Join molecule_dictionary ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno
Join compound_records ON compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Join compound_structures ON compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter molecule_dictionary.max_phase IN (3, 4)
Filter compound_records.record_id IS NOT NULL
Return molecule_chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, first_approval
Sort by molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, max_phase, first_approval"
}
